events.name: Bash
events.head: Review the latest board commit and the two probe headers
events.input: $ git show --stat af7294d | head -30 && git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs && sed -n 1,40p workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs && sed -n 1,30p workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs && date

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the public board probe against the live Worker
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && echo "LC_AGENT_RUN=$LC_AGENT_RUN"; grep -n "LC_AGENT_RUN" probe-board-actions.mjs tasks/runner.py | head; lsof -iTCP:8899 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | tail -1; date; node probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-public.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; date; grep -c "  ok  " /tmp/t322-public.log; grep -n "FAIL" /tmp/t322-public.log | head -20; tail -5 /tmp/t322-public.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the local board server and its port
events.input: $ grep -n "round trip\|probe-" /tmp/t322-public.log | head -8; ps aux | grep -E "serve\.py|tasks/server|board" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-200 | head -8; cat ../.claude/launch.json 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i -B2 -A6 "board\|tasks" | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show round trip lines and locate the board server port
events.input: $ sed -n 37,48p /tmp/t322-public.log; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -i python | awk '{print $2,$9}' | sort -u | head; ls tasks/*.py | tr '\n' ' '; grep -n "8899\|PORT" tasks/serve*.py tasks/board*.py 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the local board answers on port 8899
events.input: $ grep -rln "8899" --include=*.py --include=*.sh --include=*.json --include=*.plist . ../.claude/launch.json ~/Library/LaunchAgents 2>/dev/null | head; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8899:%{http_code}\n" -m 4 http://localhost:8899/tasks.html; lsof -iTCP:8899 -P | head -3; launchctl list | grep -i -E "tantra|launch|board" | head

events.text: Public probe is clean (72 checks, exit 0); now running the board actions probe against the local board.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the board actions probe on the local board
events.input: $ date; node probe-board-actions.mjs 8899 > /tmp/t322-actions.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; date; grep -c "  ok  " /tmp/t322-actions.log; grep -n "FAIL" /tmp/t322-actions.log | head -20; grep -n -i "github\|new tab\|pause\|sandbox" /tmp/t322-actions.log | head; tail -4 /tmp/t322-actions.log
